title: polygala vulgaris subsp. comosa
intro: Polygala vulgaris subsp. comosa, commonly known as Running Bedstraw, is a perennial plant species in the Polygalaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its use as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Running Bedstraw include its ability to exhibit expectorant properties, helping to ease coughs and congestion, and its potential as an antispasmodic, reducing muscle spasms and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Running Bedstraw include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
